source.instrument: LeCroy WavePro 740Zi, 40 GS/s, ZFL-1000LN+ amplified single-ion pulses

caveats: Measured pulses, resampled in software: each capture was recorded at 40 GS/s and reduced to 0.1 ns; lower rates are made by interpolating that trace, not by a second acquisition.
No noise is added. This measures how much of the peak a sample grid can miss; whether a slower capture sees an ion worse is a noise question the thesis answers separately (fig_capture_chain).
Worst case is over 41 phases per rate for the ensemble curve, as in the printed figure; the page's single-pulse readouts scan finer.
9 of the 152 captures clipped at the scope. They are kept, as in the printed figure; a flattened top makes their peak loss read low, so the ensemble band is if anything optimistic.
